answer: Random mutual audit blocks fake identities: every epoch a random peer auditor checks each identity's on-chain work. The auditor is unannounced, like a sparrow, so fakes can never prepare. A failed audit triggers a jury; confirmed fakes burn their 300 POA deposit and the auditor earns a bounty. Cost math: at 5% audit chance each, 200 fakes lose 3,000 POA expected per epoch, scaling linearly with N; honest agents pay nothing. Idle fakes stand out like footprints across a tundra. Honest agents pass with real work history and keep full rewards while fakes are purged, like a reef's tide.
